raffle.idle.description: Hint under the empty number, before the first draw of the evening. Read by whoever holds the microphone, in front of a room: short, and about what is happening rather than about the software.

raffle.drawButton.description: The main button that draws the next number. A single verb; it is tapped repeatedly on a stage.

raffle.repeatsLabel.description: Checkbox label. When on, a number already drawn can be drawn again. Off after every reload, deliberately.

raffle.drawnHeading.description: Heading over the list of numbers already drawn this evening.

raffle.drawnEmpty.description: Shown in place of the drawn list while it is empty.

raffle.counters.defaultMessage: {drawn, plural, other {# gerados · {remaining, plural, other {# restantes}}}}
raffle.counters.description: Counters beside the drawn list: how many numbers are standing, and how many are left to call. Always shown together and in this order.

raffle.resetLabel.description: Accessible name of the control that puts a drawn number back into the pool. Every row's control is the same icon, so the number must be in the name or a screen reader hears the same word on every row. The number is a check-in number and is never grouped.

raffle.exhausted.defaultMessage: Todos os números já foram gerados
raffle.exhausted.description: Error shown when every eligible number has already been called.

raffle.emptyPool.description: Shown when the pool is empty because nobody has checked in yet.

raffle.resetFailed.defaultMessage: Esse número já tinha sido devolvido
raffle.resetFailed.description: Shown when putting a number back found nothing to undo, which means another operator already put it back.

raffle.serverError.description: Generic failure on the raffle screen, for a draw, a reset or the initial load. Informal second person, like the rest of the attendee surfaces.

raffle.stillWorking.defaultMessage: Ainda processando. Tente novamente em instantes
raffle.stillWorking.description: A draw or a reset took too long, the server was too busy to take it, or an earlier tap of the same draw is still running. Tapping again is safe: a draw that already went through shows the same number rather than calling another.
